### Fear and Hope in God’s Jealousy
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/fear-and-hope-in-gods-jealousy
Passage: Exodus 34:14
Points:
- God is infinitely jealous for the honor of his holy name.
- Giving our ultimate affection to worldly things is spiritual adultery that invites judgment.
- For believers faithful to Christ, God's jealousy is a profound source of hope and comfort.
- God uses his omnipotence to protect the covenant good of those who belong to him.

### God Created the Sabbath for You
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-6-2022.html
Passage: Exodus 34:21
Points:
- God instituted a recurring weekly Sabbath to prevent physical and spiritual burnout.
- Believers are commanded to take time off even during the busiest work seasons.
- A restorative Sabbath involves physical rest, spiritual refocusing through worship, and emotional recharging.
- Honoring the Sabbath is an act of trust and obedience toward God's design.

### Do We Have a Jealous God?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-17-2020.html
Passage: Exodus 34:14
Points:
- Divine jealousy is a holy attribute rather than a petty human flaw.
- Because the Lord is the sole Creator, he alone has the rightful claim to our worship.
- Chasing after idols—such as wealth, intellect, or earthly achievements—dishonors God.
- True life transformation begins when we surrender self-centered desires and worship him fully.

### Praying the Names of God - August 20
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-september-1.html
Passage: Exodus 34:14
Points:
- God's jealousy is an expression of deep, burning love that refuses to share our hearts with idols.
- God persistently pursues wandering souls rather than remaining indifferent to our waywardness.
- Recognizing divine pursuit calls for abandoning competing affections in our personal walk.
- Believers are called to pray persistently for family and friends being pursued by God's love.
